description: Whether a test on jest-environment-jsdom has Node's fetch API, and whether a package that looks for `fetch` as it loads finds it (as @iconify/react does, which then loads its icons over the network, with replies that can come after the window closed). Each test's title holds what its file saw. `window.test.ts` is a jsdom file; `node.test.ts` is a node file through its docblock. Jest's window has no `fetch`, `Request`, `Response` or `Headers`; a node file has all four.
